en.flavor: A dully gilded catalyst secretly guarded in the Blackcliff Forge. It seems to glow with the very light from the sky.

refinements.1: Using an Elemental Burst regenerates <r>4</r> Energy every 2s for 6s. All party members will regenerate <r>4%</r> HP every 2s for this duration.
refinements.2: Using an Elemental Burst regenerates <r>4.5</r> Energy every 2s for 6s. All party members will regenerate <r>4.5%</r> HP every 2s for this duration.
refinements.3: Using an Elemental Burst regenerates <r>5</r> Energy every 2s for 6s. All party members will regenerate <r>5%</r> HP every 2s for this duration.
refinements.4: Using an Elemental Burst regenerates <r>5.5</r> Energy every 2s for 6s. All party members will regenerate <r>5.5%</r> HP every 2s for this duration.
refinements.5: Using an Elemental Burst regenerates <r>6</r> Energy every 2s for 6s. All party members will regenerate <r>6%</r> HP every 2s for this duration.

fr.flavor: Un catalyseur magique découvert à la Forge de Rochenoire. La lumière du soleil, de la lune et des étoiles semble s'en dégager.
